goal: The lending-room import must accept returns as well as withdrawals. Repair inventory.ledger.apply_movements(stock, movements), where each pair is an item and signed integer delta: positive adds stock, negative consumes it, zero is allowed for a known item. Process repeated items in order and require every intermediate balance to be nonnegative. Apply the whole iterable atomically: any unknown item (KeyError) or insufficient intermediate balance (ValueError) leaves stock unchanged. Return None on success. Keep reserve strictly positive as documented; its existing tests must continue to pass unchanged.
